T84 Campaign snapshot tests. Added RPC.Tests/CampaignSnapshotTests.cs (test-authoring only; no product behavior changed, no engine bug surfaced). Three hand-authored campaign configs with distinct six-roll combinations (A: bureau/convocation/cartography, BloomHarvest, stillness, BloomSiege; B: convocation/stillness/inkblood, EngineSeizure, bureau, ErraticEngine; C: cartography/inkblood/bureau, TheResurrection, convocation, OpenWar), each with distinct faction timelines + wildcard turn thresholds. Per-config Theory assertions: config validates (six-roll consistency), GenerateOverworld produces a valid dungeon sequence (>=1 dungeon, broken_engine present, every dungeon carries a template id and is reachable from the_reach via undirected BFS over the route graph), evidence count reaches 10 via AddEvidence and unlocks accusation, faction reputation transitions Investigating->Preparing->Executing fire at the exact timeline turns, and Wild Card trigger conditions (turn>=threshold AND rep>=20) are reachable -> Offered. Plus a deterministic 35-turn simulation (3 seeds 1/7/99) driving IncrementTurns(1) in Exploration mode to the turn limit: asserts no crash (40-iter safety), Turns clamps to 35, CampaignEnded, Mode forced to Menu, CurrentDungeon null, threat faction reached Executing with a state_executing milestone in the action log, and settlement fates resolved (no 'pending' left). All RNG seeded; mirrors EventSchedulerTests/WildCardTests + SynergySnapshotTests conventions. Verified green THIS turn: dotnet build 0 warnings/0 errors, dotnet test 1268 passed (1250 prior + 18 new), 0 failed. Changes left unstaged for loop driver.

T56 Roster/bench system (engine-only). Design choice: reused existing PartyState aggregate (Members[6] active + Bench list + DeadCharacters) instead of a parallel RosterState. Added PartyState.MaxRosterSize=12, RosterCount (living active + bench), SwapActiveBench(slot, benchId?) (paired swap or bench-out with can't-empty-active guard), DismissCharacter(id) (removes from roster, never to dead, refuses last living active). TownService gates both town-only (Mode==Menu, so rejected mid-combat) + emits action logs; GameState delegates. RecruitFromTavern now rejects at roster cap 12. CombatService field promotion: active members below active-party average level gain +50% XP (round); bench chars are not combatants so intrinsically earn no combat XP. Typed pipeline: SwapActiveBenchCommand/DismissCharacterCommand + GameCommandHandler cases + CommandDispatcher swap_active_bench/dismiss_character factories. Save schema bumped 8->9: SaveData.Bench added, BuildBench/restore + SaveMetadata bench class-id validation + SaveSystem pipeline targets CurrentSchemaVersion; v9 golden fixture added, migration/golden tests updated. State payload exposes bench + rosterInfo (cap/atCap) via PartyPresenter for UI tasks T57/bench-view. Protocol synced (fixture + protocol-gen schema + regenerated protocol.gen.ts); client UiIntent gained swapActiveBench/dismissCharacter + intentToAction + game.ts BenchMember/RosterInfo types. Verified green THIS turn: dotnet build 0 errors, dotnet test 1250 passed (incl. 12 RosterBenchSystemTests + v9 golden), client npm run check 0 errors, build clean, test:unit 41 passed.

Added server-authoritative equip/unequip API through the typed command pipeline. New EquipmentSystem (RPC.Engine/Inventory) with pure Equip/Unequip returning EquipResult: validates item exists in registry, item type/slot fits target equipment slot (weapon->mainHand/offHand, armor->armor, accessory->accessory1/2), item is in the character's ComponentInventory; equipping moves item inventory->slot (swapping any prior item back), unequipping moves slot->inventory respecting MaxComponentSlots capacity (inventory-full guard). EffectiveStats recompute is implicit (computed on-demand from Equipment). Equipment record gained GetSlot/WithSlot/IsValidSlot helpers. Commands EquipItemCommand/UnequipItemCommand + CommandDispatcher equip_item/unequip_item factories; PlayerAction gained ItemId+EquipSlot; GameCommandHandler now takes ItemRegistry, finds member by id, applies move, emits item_equipped/item_unequipped action logs; GameServer wires content.ItemRegistry. Protocol synced: Fixtures/protocol-schema.json + tools/protocol-gen/schema.json + regenerated protocol.gen.ts. Equipment already in PartyPresenter payload + game.ts types. Client UiIntent gained equipItem/unequipItem variants + intentToAction mapping. Class restrictions content-gated (ItemDef has no class-restriction field; not fabricated). Full inventory UI deferred to dW2dGEI8NdhA per scope note. Verified green THIS turn: dotnet test 1236 passed (incl. 9 EquipmentSystemTests + 2 protocol-sync), client npm run check 0 errors, build clean, test:unit 38 passed.

Death/downed/resurrection economy already fully implemented and committed across all 6 deliverables; STEP-0 assessment found no gap. Engine core: downed=CurrentHp 0, Stabilized=StatusEffect 'stabilized'; combat-end resolution in GameState.SubmitCombatAction (downed+unstabilized -> moved to Party.DeadCharacters with character_died log; stabilized -> survives at 1 HP with character_stabilized log). TownService.ResurrectCharacter enforces 500g+1TT/-1stat (1st), 1500g+2TT/-2stat+BranchAdvancementLocked (2nd), permadeath (3rd), plus gold/tithe/party-full/unknown guards. ResurrectionResult record, ResurrectionAttempts + BranchAdvancementLocked on CharacterState, save schema v8 persistence. Client wiring complete: resurrect uiIntent -> resurrect_character command -> CommandDispatcher -> GameCommandHandler -> ResurrectCharacter; PartyPresenter.PresentDeadCharacters emits resurrectionCost/titheTokenCost; game.ts DeadCharacter type; Bone Clerk UI panel in TownServicesPanel.svelte (dead rows, tithe tokens, cost-gated resurrect buttons, permadeath state). Verified green THIS turn: dotnet test 1227 passed (incl. 13 DeathAndResurrectionTests), client npm run check 0 errors, test:unit 36 passed, test:e2e:fresh 39 passed. No code changes needed; no UI follow-up required.

Typed client action-log events + server-reconciled synergy journal. Added parseActionLogEntry discriminated-union parser (shared/types/actionLogEvents.ts) projecting rep_changed/synergy_triggered/faction-* entries into typed events with defaults; unknown entries -> null (tolerates truncated snapshot tails). Rewrote actionLogFeedback.ts to consume the typed parser, eliminating all `any` log scanning. Synergy defs already content-driven (shared/data/synergies.ts via content/synergies/*.json glob) — confirmed not hardcoded. Exposed authoritative journal.discoveredSynergies in StatePresenter state snapshot (from campaign Journal save state); client reconcileJournal (shared/stores/synergyJournal.ts) merges localStorage mirror against server discovery on every frame so journal survives save/load without browser-only reliance; prior-session discoveries surface as revealed. Tests: 14 client unit (parser + reconcile + memory persistence), 2 engine StatePresenter journal serialization. Plan adjustment: full server-side 'revealed' persistence not needed — server tracks discovered, revealed is a client reveal-timing concept reconciled from server discovered; localStorage retained as reconciled cache per load-bearing design call. Verify: check 0 errors, unit 36 passed, build clean, dotnet 1227 passed, e2e:fresh 39 passed.

Introduced a renderer view-model boundary. New pure mapping src/renderer/RenderModel.ts defines RenderModel (dungeonType, hasDungeon, tiles, player, combat) plus toRenderModel(GameState) which reduces the full client GameState to only the geometry/theme/creature-placement data the renderer needs; combat is included only while mode==='Combat' with live combat state. DungeonRenderer.updateState now accepts RenderModel and the renderer no longer imports GameState or CombatState/Combatant types (imports Tile + render-model types from ./RenderModel only). updateCreatures/detectUnaccountedAttacks refactored to take RenderCombat + RenderPlayer. RendererHost.update maps via toRenderModel(state) at the single call site. Behavior identical — renderer output unchanged. TDD: wrote RenderModel.test.ts RED first (6 cases: exploration mapping, default/empty scene, drop-combat-when-not-Combat-mode, combat creature placement, combat-log mapping for unaccounted detection, null combat when Combat mode lacks state). VERIFICATION (fresh this turn): npm run check 0 errors/0 warnings; npm run build clean; npm run test:unit 22/22 (6 new); npm run test:e2e:fresh 39/39 green (8.6m). Changes left unstaged for the loop driver.

Leak-hunt on the reused local RPC.Host. TWO root-cause signals. (1) Connection/session path is CLEAN: ClientRegistry.Remove runs in WebSocketConnectionHandler's finally and the per-client heartbeat loop exits on socket close; new stress test SessionLeakStressTests opens+aborts 200 WebSocket sessions and asserts the new server-side GameServer.ClientCount returns to baseline 0 -> no unbounded connection/session leak. (2) GENUINE per-frame growth leak FOUND+FIXED: StatePresenter.CreateStateMessage serialized the ENTIRE GameState.ActionLog into every state snapshot. ActionLog grows for a campaign's life (only cleared on reset_game) and the host is reused across many e2e runs locally, so each 'ready'/state-change frame's serialization cost grew O(accumulated-commands) and was fan-broadcast to all clients -- matching the reported 'per-test time balloons after many runs' symptom (code even had a dormant 1000-entry log-rotation warning, evidencing known unbounded growth). FIX: cap the snapshot's serialized actionLog to the most recent 200 entries (StatePresenter.SnapshotActionLogLimit) via a recent-tail Skip; stored ActionLog untouched so engine logic/tests are unaffected, and the client only consumes entries newer than its last-seen turn so a recent tail suffices. The 'host degrades after hours' note from iter20 is a separate compounding WSL2 GC/RSS factor; addressed deterministically by a host-restart harness: src/client/scripts/e2e-fresh.sh kills any stale RPC.Host (by :19421 and process name) before invoking Playwright on a fresh backend, wired as npm scripts test:e2e and test:e2e:fresh. Repo hygiene: git rm -r --cached src/client/test-results (already covered by root .gitignore 'test-results/'). VERIFICATION (fresh this turn): dotnet build clean (0 warn/0 err); full engine dotnet test 1225/1225 passed incl new SessionLeakStressTests + StatePresenterTests cap test; client npm run check exit 0; harness bash -n OK; package.json valid JSON. Changes left unstaged (the test-results untrack is necessarily staged as a deletion).

Debugged the 8 flaky e2e failures (branch-choice x3, downtime x3, faction-patrol x2). ROOT CAUSE: their shared loadTown() waited for .town-menu to render from the LIVE backend's pushed mode before injecting test state, but the dotnet host is shared and reused locally (reuseExistingServer). When a prior test/run left the backend in Combat/Exploration, mode!=Menu so .town-menu never appeared and the specs failed — proven by 3/3 isolation failure on the dirty backend. game.spec avoids this by sending reset_game first. FIX: added e2e/townHarness.ts with a deterministic loadTown() that injects a minimal Menu state via __testSetState (engages the store override gate, fully isolating from backend mode); the 3 specs now import it. Resolves the iter18(green)/iter19(8-fail) contradiction: iter18 ran on a fresh Menu backend, iter19 on a reused dirty one. Also de-flaked map-combat:152 (real combat) whose enter_combat->Combat wait used the 10s default vs the file's 20s convention; aligned to 20000ms, 4/4 green after. RESULTS: 8/8 target specs green in isolation; full suite 39/39 green on final-A AND on a fresh-backend run (8.9m normal speed). SPLIT OUT: a separate run (final-B) showed keybindings:47 + map-combat:50 fail with ballooned 46-60s durations after hours of continuous backend reuse — pure host resource degradation (neither touched by this change; both green on fresh host). Filed follow-up for e2e backend-reuse degradation. check 0 errors, build clean, 16/16 unit tests pass. Changes left unstaged.

Enforced unidirectional client action dispatch. Added pure intent->action adapter src/client/src/shared/actions/uiIntent.ts (UiIntent union + intentToAction) with 16 vitest unit tests (uiIntent.test.ts); installed vitest + added test:unit script + vite test config. Converted the three presentation components that bypassed the dispatch path: CombatOverlay (removed direct sendAction for UseAbility; now emits combatAbility/combatAction/flee intents via onIntent, dropped onCombatAction/onFlee props), TownMenu (rest/verifyRumor/branchChoose/transferTo/FromCache via onIntent), TownServicesPanel (downtime/verifyRumor/wildcardAlliance/resurrect via onIntent). App.svelte added single dispatchIntent(intent)=>sendAction(intentToAction(intent)); routed combat + cache + town recruit/mission/vendor handlers through it; removed dead handleCombatAction/handleFlee. grep confirms zero sendAction/gameStore imports remain in src/client/src/features/. npm run check 0 errors, build clean, 16/16 unit tests pass. e2e: 31 passed / 8 failed (branch-choice x3, downtime x3, faction-patrol x2) — PROVEN PRE-EXISTING via git stash: identical 8-failure set on clean HEAD with my changes stashed, so behavior preserved, no regression. NOTE: dispatch expected 39-green baseline but actual current-branch baseline is 31-green; pre-existing 8 failures warrant a separate investigation task.

Fixed 7 pre-existing e2e failures, root-caused to two prior refactors. (1) display-settings x3: accessibility section reused FOV/display CSS classes (fov-slider, display-value, display-select), causing strict-mode ambiguity. Product fix: gave Text Size slider/value and Colorblind select distinct classes (slider/a11y-value/a11y-select) with shared styling preserved via grouped selectors; FOV/Resolution selectors now unique. (2) downtime x3 + branch-choice modal-block x1: commit d377084 broadsheet refactor swapped PartyPanel->PartyBroadsheet and dropped TownServicesPanel from the party tab, orphaning the downtime UI (dead activeTab==='tavern' block) and .character-card. Product fix: re-gated downtime on activeTab='downtime' and mounted TownServicesPanel activeTab='downtime' on the party tab, restoring the reachable feature without duplicating tavern content. Test fix (justified): branch-choice modal-block test updated stale .character-card -> .rail-row (PartyBroadsheet roster). check 0 errors, build clean, full e2e 39 passed 0 failed.

Routed dungeon generation through content-defined templates. Added DungeonContentSet (RPC.Engine) owning template validation (segment ids, encounter table, display name, watcher path), watcher-path derivation, and directory->template mapping — outside GameServer. Added segmentDirectory to DungeonTemplate + all 11 template JSONs. GameServer now watches every content-defined segment directory (not hard-coded broken-engine) and ReloadSegments reports affected dungeon/template via BroadcastContentReload(affectedDungeons). ContentBootstrap validates fail-fast at load. 8 new tests incl. two-dungeon-type distinct routing. dotnet test: 1223 passed.
